offering_description.value: Provides hot-dip galvanizing and metal coating services for steel and manufactures electrical equipment and products for utilities and industrial customers. Sells to steel fabricators, utilities and industrial buyers, using its own plants to coat and process metal.

primary_products.value: electrical equipment; conduit and fittings; bus duct; coated metal products

primary_services.value: hot-dip galvanizing; metal coating; powder coating; metal finishing

customer_segment.value: B2B: steel fabricators, electrical contractors, utilities, industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: utilities; construction; industrial manufacturing; infrastructure; energy

revenue_model.value: service fees: coating and galvanizing services charged per job or volume; product sales: electrical equipment and conduit sold to contractors and utilities

value_chain_position.value: service provider: coats and finishes customers' steel products for a fee; OEM / manufacturer: builds electrical equipment and products from purchased metal and components, sold to contractors and utilities

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with plants and customers in Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: metal coatings and galvanizing services, electrical equipment and products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large fabricators and utilities; distributors / dealers: electrical distributors reselling electrical products to contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and emissions rules for zinc coating plants, workplace safety rules, and product electrical safety standards

notes: Recent portfolio changes may not be fully reflected in the product and service lists.
